messages.content: What is the value of the 'EnableExtensions' property in the Windows registry `WinReg` object under the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE root when checking the system policies for the DBeaver application?

function.name: BasePolicyDataProvider_getRegistryPolicyValue
function.description: Retrieves the value of a specified property from the DBeaver registry policy node if it exists, specifically for Windows systems. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

root.description: The root key in the Windows registry (e.g., HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE). This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

property.description: The name of the property to retrieve the value for from the registry. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

They want to retrieve a registry value. We have a tool: BasePolicyDataProvider_getRegistryPolicyValue. We need to call it with root: "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE" and property: "EnableExtensions". The question is about DBeaver application system policies. The property likely resides under a subkey for DBeaver. But the tool signature only takes root and property. It might assume the property path includes subkeys. So we should pass the full property path: "Software\\DBeaver\\EnableExtensions" or something. But the user didn't specify subkey. The question: "value of the 'EnableExtensions' property in the Windows registry `WinReg` object under the HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE root when checking the system policies for the DBeaver application?" So property: "EnableExtensions". Root: "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE". We'll call the tool.
